Procedure:
 Equipment Inspection (I2-Y1)
Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The boiler plant is equipped with
two regenerative ljungstrom air heaters.

The ljungstrom
air preheater absorbs waste heat from flue gas then transfers
this heat to uncoming cold air by means of
continuously rotating heat transfer elements of
specially formed metal plates.

Thousands of these high efficiency
elements are spaced and compactly arranged within sectorshaped compartments
of radially divided cylindrical shell called the
rotor.

The housing surrounding the rotor
is provided with duct connections at both ends and is adequately sealed by
radial and circumferential sealing members forming an air passage through one
half of the preheater and a gas passage through one half of the preheater and a
gas passage through the other.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Wear safety helmet, shoes,
gloves etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of the
main motor
Be sure that the air preheater is stopped completely visually

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out

Check all drive unit coupling and gears for unusual 
noise oil leakage excessive vibration, and temperature, so change the defected 
parts from O-seals, bearings ... etc

Check PH lubrication system for
oil leakage, pressure and temperature.

Check MW load, air and gas
temperature in and out differential pressure across the air preheater.

Inspect axial radial and circumference
seal condition change if required.

Adjust axial, radial and circumferential seal 
clearances, or change any of the defected seals in outage and readjust the 
clearance.

Inspect shaft seals and change
if required.

Check heat transfer and
elements and change if required.

Check soot blowing lance and
nozzles and change if required.

Change oil in air preheater 
bearing mobil extra hecla super cylinder oil.
Clean oil filter with air and organic substances.

Restart lubricating system and check the air 
pressure.

Change oil lubrication shaft bearings for Reduction 
gear QSV 320
Change oil, clean air filter, top oiler (Vactra heavy medium) for the Air motor.

Check Automatic friction coupling 
for 
bushing wear and change if needed.
Check free of oil or grease.

Hydrodynamic coupling check and restart the air 
preheater.
